cache.clear_description: Frees the cached downloads. Files are re-fetched from the network the next time they're needed.

close_action.hint: Servers and game sessions keep running whichever you pick — the daemon outlives the window, and a workload outlives the daemon.
close_action.label: When the window is closed
close_action.quit: Close the window, leave the daemon running
close_action.stop_daemon: Close the window and stop the daemon

settings.curseforge_key_hint: CurseForge only answers requests carrying a key, so it is offered as a source once you set one. Get yours from console.curseforge.com.

daemon.hint: The background process every front-end talks to. Restarting it stops nothing you have running.
daemon.title: Daemon

settings.data_dir_confirm_description: The daemon restarts to serve instances, servers and runtimes from the new path, and refuses while anything is running. Existing files are not moved for you — point this at a directory you have already moved, or Hestia starts empty there.
settings.default_memory_hint: Instances and servers can override this individually.

discord.enabled_description: Show what you are playing on your Discord profile. Needs the Discord desktop app running on this machine.

instances.multi_session_description: Advanced. Launch an instance again while it is already running. Sessions share one set of worlds, configs and mods — Minecraft only guards a world against being opened twice.

java.runtimes_hint: Entries install what they need on their own; installing here just gets it over with.
java.uninstall_description: {name} will be removed. Entries that need it reinstall it on the next start.

settings.keep_open: Keep the launcher open while a game runs

modpack.default_excludes_hint: Off, a pack is trusted exactly as published — client mods included.
modpack.hint: Packs routinely declare client-only mods as server-compatible. Hestia holds those back when installing a pack on a server.
modpack.overrides_exclusions_hint: Config and world files the pack ships that should not be written. ? one character, * a run within one folder, ** a run across folders.
modpack.title: Modpacks

approval.full_access_warning: This plugin asks for full access to your computer: it can change your servers and instances, install content and run programs.
approval.more: …and more. The full list is on the Plugins page.

browse.none: Add a repository to browse the plugins it offers.

plugins.obsolete_hint: No repository you added lists this plugin any more. It keeps running, but gets no updates.
plugins.official_hint: Signed by the official Hestia plugins key.

repos.hint: A repository is trusted by its signing key. Only plugins signed with that key are installed from it or updated through it.
repos.remove_description: Plugins installed from it keep running, but get no updates.
repos.title: Repositories
repos.trust_description: Plugins signed with key {key} will be installable from {name}. Check that the key matches what its author publishes.

plugins.full_access_hint: Can change your servers and instances, install content or run programs.
plugins.hint: Plugins extend Hestia. A plugin only gets what you approve when you install it.
plugins.link_hint: An https link to a .hplugin file. Hestia downloads it once and shows what it asks for before installing anything.
plugins.needs_approval_hint: Its package changed since you approved it. Install it again to review what it asks for.
plugins.remove_description: This removes the plugin and deletes all the data it stored. It can't be undone.
plugins.review_hint: This list is too long for the approval dialog. Read it here, then continue.

storage.hint: Downloads Hestia can fetch again — safe to reclaim at any time.
storage.title: Storage

settings.subtitle: Launcher, runtimes and daemon

sync.description: Each one is merged at every launch, so two instances changing different things both survive.

options.empty: No shared settings yet — they arrive the first time an instance launches.
options.hint: The shared game settings, one by one. Turn one off and every instance keeps its own value for it.
options.label: Shared game settings

source.description: The shared copy starts as one instance's. The others take it at their next launch.
source.label: Instance
source.none: No instance has this file yet, so the shared copy starts empty and fills at the first launch.
source.required: Pick an instance to start from.
source.title: Which instance starts it?

theme.failed: The theme "{name}" could not be loaded and was turned off.
theme.hint: A theme from an installed plugin restyles the app. Turning the plugin off, or removing it, returns to the built-in look.
theme.label: Theme

tutorial.hint: Each page walks you through itself again the next time you open it.
tutorial.label: Tutorial
tutorial.reset: The tutorial will replay as you open each page

update.channel_hint: Beta builds arrive first and can be unstable. Switching back to stable waits for the next stable release to overtake the beta you are on.
update.manual: This copy of Hestia updates itself elsewhere — download {version} from the release page
update.restart_required: Update installed — restart Hestia to run it
update.title: Updates
